summary: Self-caught regression in my own candidate, found by running the remedy and reading git diff rather than by reading code: replacing Directory.GetFiles(..., AllDirectories) with a hand-written depth-first walk changed the ENUMERATION ORDER, so KitPins rewrote scripts/kit-pins.json with six lines moved and every digest identical. Nothing went red anywhere - the order of a generated data file was an undeclared part of its contract, and no gate could see the change. Three directory/file prefix pairs in this kit hit it.
evidence: command:dotnet fsi build.fsx -t KitPins then git diff scripts/kit-pins.json -> 4 insertions, 4 deletions, all reorderings, no digest changed; command:after the sort, the same sequence leaves git status --porcelain clean
cost: would have shipped a gratuitous diff on a file four merged audits bind; caught before review

summary: KitPins wrote a ledger that does not parse and exited 0: renderKitPins interpolated the path into JSON raw, so a kit file named with a quote produced 64 of 192 kit files pinned on the next run, and re-running the remedy the gate names reproduced it.
